mapper.select: SELECT address_id, member_id, recipient, phone, phone_norm, zipcode, road_address, detail_address, entrance_method, delivery_memo, is_default, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at FROM MEMBER_ADDRESSES WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY last_used_at DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT address_id, is_default, last_used_at, created_at FROM MEMBER_ADDRESSES WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND del_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_ADDRESSES (member_id, recipient, phone, phone_norm, zipcode, road_address, detail_address, entrance_method, delivery_memo, is_default, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{recipient}, #{phone}, #{phoneNorm}, #{zipcode}, #{roadAddress}, #{detailAddress}, #{entranceMethod}, #{deliveryMemo}, #{isDefault}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_ADDRESSES SET is_default = 'N' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_default = 'Y' AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT address_id, member_id, recipient, phone, phone_norm, zipcode, road_address, detail_address, entrance_method, delivery_memo, is_default, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at FROM MEMBER_ADDRESSES WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND del_yn = 'N' AND address_id != #{excludeAddressId} ORDER BY last_used_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
